newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in quiet trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in early trading on Tuesday on sustained poor buying interest amid falls in Malaysia, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,380-85 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from Monday's close, but trades were also heard at 1,375 rupiah. Crude palm oil was done at 1,179 and 1,181 rupiah/kg in Medan at a tender on Monday.

"Buyers are afraid to take fresh positions because they feel prices could go down further," one trader said. "Some who bought at 1,400 rupiah are caught because they did not anticipate prices to weaken to current levels."
The traders said prices also remained under pressure due to falls in Chicago soyoil futures overnight where the July contract fell 0.20 cents to close at 23.13 cents a lb.

"The Malaysian market is continuing to fall this morning, and this is expected to keep our market slow," one said. "Some players were expecting local prices to bottom out this week, but it seems the expectations were a little premature."
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Sea Stork will leave the North Sumatran port on Wednesday for Bombay with 1,100 tonnes of palm fatty acid and 1,400 tonnes of palm oil.
The MT Sceptre will leave on Tuesday for Port Klang with 14,400 tonnes of crude palm oil.
The MT Kabanjahe will enter Belawan from Palembang on Wednesday with 2,107 tonnes of palm kernal expeller.
